mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM app_user WHERE email = #{email}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO app_user(name, email, password_hash, phone_number, address) VALUES (#{name}, #{email}, #{passwordHash}, #{phoneNumber}, #{address})

INSERT INTO app_user(name, email, password_hash, phone_number, address, oauth_provider, oauth_provider_id) VALUES (#{name}, #{email}, #{passwordHash}, #{phoneNumber}, #{address}, #{oauthProvider}, #{oauthProviderId})
mapper.select: SELECT id, name, email, password_hash AS passwordHash, phone_number AS phoneNumber, address, oauth_provider AS oauthProvider, oauth_provider_id AS oauthProviderId FROM app_user WHERE email = #{email}
SELECT id, name, email, password_hash AS passwordHash, phone_number AS phoneNumber, address, oauth_provider AS oauthProvider, oauth_provider_id AS oauthProviderId FROM app_user WHERE id = #{userId}
SELECT id, name, email, phone_number AS phoneNumber FROM app_user WHERE name = #{name} AND REPLACE(IFNULL(phone_number, ''), '-', '') = REPLACE(#{phoneNumber}, '-', '') LIMIT 1
mapper.delete: DELETE pl FROM community_post_like pl INNER JOIN community_post p ON p.id = pl.post_id WHERE p.user_id = #{userId}
